label: Eric W. Davis
narrative: Davis is the single most important technical witness on this board because his key act is documented rather than merely asserted. He is an astrophysicist who worked under Puthoff at EarthTech International and, as the cover page of DIA-08-1004-004 states in plain type, authored 'Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy' for the DIA Defense Warning Office's Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications programme - dated 6 April 2010, produced in FY2009, with James T. Lacatski, D.Eng., named as AAWSA programme manager and the return address given as Bldg 6000, Washington DC 20340-5100. He co-authored a second DIRD, 'Warp Drive, Dark Energy, and the Manipulation of Extra Dimensions', with Richard Obousy. He was a subcontractor and then consultant to the Pentagon UFO programme from 2007. On 23 July 2020 The New York Times reported, on the record, that Davis - by then at The Aerospace Corporation - had given a classified briefing to a Defense Department agency as recently as March 2020 about retrievals from 'off-world vehicles not made on this earth', and that he had given classified briefings on retrievals of unexplained objects to staff members of the Senate Armed Services Committee on 21 October 2019 and to members of the Senate Intelligence Committee two days later. Of the materials he said: 'We couldn't make it ourselves.' Those are dated events with named committees, and they are the reason the phrase 'off-world vehicles' entered the congressional record's ambient vocabulary. Davis is also the author of record of the notes of an alleged October 2002 meeting with Vice Adm. Thomas R. Wilson, which surfaced in 2019 among the papers of the late Edgar Mitchell and describe a special access programme concealed from a sitting DIA director.

unverified: Whether AAWSAP funds paid for any Davis work beyond the five named DIRDs.

NewsNation reported in August 2026 (Katie Pavlich Tonight) that Davis said he has 'seen the evidence' and 'seen the records' of recovered non-human bodies of 'a minimum of four' species and asked the White House for immunity before a fuller account. The NewsNation pages could not be opened from this environment (bot wall), so the statement is recorded here as unverified rather than carried as a claim.
